preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'B', 'R'} for _, _, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must be colored either 'B' (blue) or 'R' (red).

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not possible else True
postconditions.description: If it is not possible to make all edges the same color, output '-1'.
If possible, output the minimum number of moves k followed by k vertex indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(vertex) <= n for vertex in vertices)
postconditions.description: All output vertex indices must be within the range of 1 to n.
